notes.text: Available in cPanel 136 and later. Read-only account-wide WHM inventory lists each cPanel account's web log retention preference alongside the server-wide default from Tweak Settings. This is separate from the selected-account LogManager settings and does not modify settings.

default_retention and per-account retention_days are integer days; zero means logs are retained indefinitely. An explicit null account retention_days means the account uses the server default, while omission remains absent. using_default remains a native boolean, unlike UAPI LogManager integer flags. Account user/domain strings, optional fields and empty account lists are preserved. API success establishes inventory only and does not prove eventual retention enforcement.

evidence.note: Pinned /list_accounts_retention GET declares x-readonly=true with no parameters.
